Sofia, the Hagerstown driver was at Door 4B. You posted that in #coastal-random on 13 Oct. The driver was from Covey & Lark Retail and was arguing with the guard shack over a barcode scanner.

Covey & Lark Retail was the old name of Pellow Home Living. The rename happened in February, so I can't tell from the thread whether Door 4B belongs to the same account as the door 6 lamp delivery.
